summary: Lists file types Vault can encrypt in full: inventory group and host vars, -e @file vars, include_vars/vars_files, role vars and defaults, tasks and handlers files, and arbitrary binary files; it uses an editor to create or modify them.
questions: Which files can I encrypt with Ansible Vault?
Can I encrypt a tasks file or handlers file?
Can Ansible Vault encrypt binary files?

answer_card.title: Files Ansible Vault can encrypt
answer_card.answer_md:
Vault can encrypt the whole of any structured data file Ansible uses:

- inventory group_vars and host_vars files
- vars files passed with `-e @file.yml` / `-e @file.json`
- files loaded by `include_vars` or `vars_files`
- role vars and defaults files
- tasks and handlers files
- binary or other arbitrary files

Vault uses your editor to create or modify encrypted files, so secure your editor.
